promises.label: Deliver reset 2026 return target
promises.commitment: Under the reset plan, deliver 10%–11% RoTCE in 2026.
promises.outcomeSummary: Citi raised full-year RoTCE guidance above 11%; delivery remained pending because this was a forecast, not a completed full-year result.

promises.label: Expand share repurchases
promises.commitment: Execute a $20 billion share repurchase program, with no specified completion deadline.
promises.outcomeSummary: Citi reported $0.5 billion remaining and no further planned purchases under the original $20 billion program; the new $30 billion authorization was separate.

missing.what_was_said: Management reaffirmed repurchases each quarter under the $20 billion program, expected to buy back at least $4 billion in the current quarter, and said investors should not expect precise quarterly buyback guidance going forward.
Management reported $5 billion of share repurchases, $1 billion more than guided. This adds above-guidance execution to the reaffirmation captured in S4.
Management said it had launched its $30 billion common-stock repurchase commitment by buying back $4 billion during the quarter.

promises.label: Improve full-year operating efficiency
promises.commitment: Achieve an efficiency ratio of around 60% for full-year 2026.
promises.outcomeSummary: Full-year 2026 results remained pending; management strengthened its efficiency-ratio outlook from around 60% to below 60%.

missing.what_was_said: In the Q&A, Mark Mason confirmed that the previous below-60% efficiency-ratio target had moved to around 60%, providing flexibility to invest beyond 2026. This shows that the January formulation relaxed earlier guidance before the outlook subsequently strengthened.

promises.label: Grow non-Markets net interest income
promises.commitment: Increase NII excluding Markets by 5%–6% in 2026.
promises.outcomeSummary: Full-year guidance was raised to the mid-to-high 6% range; the 2026 result remained pending.

promises.label: Deconsolidate Banamex
promises.commitment: Deconsolidate Banamex in early 2027, following accelerated stake sales.
promises.outcomeSummary: Citi had divested 49% of Banamex and was preparing for deconsolidation in early 2027; the original target remained pending.
